distributionProposalForMain.name: vertex-control-client
distributionProposalForMain.dependencyNote: Main owns transport-only deps=[] packaging. create_research_adapters and domain methods lazily hard-import knowledge/providers/agents/strategies from host-installed vertex-gamma-research; they are not stdlib-only standalone features.

authority.requirements: Host injects independently pinned generated bundle authority with worker, policy, model-use and epoch schemas. No native permissive fallback validators. Source-only work did not generate or execute a bundle.

config.origin: required explicit HTTPS origin; no path/trailing slash/query/fragment/userinfo
config.credential_ref: required explicit resolver reference, repr suppressed
config.max_request_bytes: ordinary requests default and ceiling 2097152; approved replayNativeOutbox route alone uses fixed 12582912 request limit

transport.headers: Authorization Bearer resolved only through configured reference; Origin equals config.origin; JSON identity encoding; no sec-fetch-site, proxy discovery or redirect following
transport.tls: ssl.create_default_context with hostname verification and CERT_REQUIRED; credentials written only after connect/TLS; no configurable insecure context
transport.codec: Standard same-oRPC JSON request {json:payload} / response {json:result}; unknown meta/special serializer values rejected
transport.lifecycle: async context manager and aclose(); public async snake_case(**wire_fields) and call(camelCaseMethod,payload)->dict
transport.nativeReplay: WorkerReplayNativeOutboxInput -> WorkerProjectionAck; fence plus original signed bounded NativeOutboxReplay, <=64 rows, <=8388608 aggregate decoded bytes verified by actual authority. Dedicated replay request ceiling12582912 per authoritative MAX_NATIVE_OUTBOX_REPLAY_WIRE_BYTES; response stays2097152 and ordinary artifact/raw/other method bounds unchanged. No retries; partial replay or lost acknowledgement is unknown effect.
transport.nativeReplayV4: Public freeze v4 requires replay.retainedEpochTransitionBase64 and replay.grant.retainedEpochTransitionSha256 as nullable fields; both explicit null on normal replay, both present on retained transition replay. Generic client preserves complete payload unchanged and validates actual Worker registry authority; no cloned shape or default insertion. Aggregate decoded bound includes grant approval and retained transition bytes. Current authoritative source inspected; no execution.
transport.failure: ControlError(code,effect) sanitized; retryable=False. Once mutation send may begin, response loss, malformed/oversize response, redirects or HTTP failure are effect=unknown. No automatic retry. Host reconciles status/durable output IDs before an explicitly authorized follow-up.
transport.cancellation: ControlCancelled preserves asyncio cancellation with effect classification; active socket closed best-effort. OS DNS/thread completion cannot be forcibly terminated; cancelled exchange is checked before credential transmission.

adapters.bridge: LoopBridge(explicit_running_host_loop,timeout_seconds=120); synchronous ports run off-loop (e.g. host asyncio.to_thread). Any running loop on caller thread fails before coroutine creation. No new scheduler or polling loop.
adapters.runBinding: RunBinding(run_id,trace_id,request_digest,token_budget,cost_budget_usd), keyword-only. Host must validate against lease inputs. request_digest is canonical agents.wire.internal_value(RunRequest), preserving *_ns as strings. Admission accepts newly accepted only; duplicate never reauthorizes compute.
adapters.rights: decide(RightRequest), authorize(...), resolve_current(...); fresh current scope/hash/review/rights joins, no acceptanceStatus authorization or cached accepted fallback. Exact public SemVer retained in review pins; private integer revision is lossless length-prefixed encoding only while JSON-safe, otherwise denial.
adapters.retention: retention_policy_bindings maps (rightsPolicyId,currentRightsVersion) to exact selected retentionPolicyId. Host populates only from verified selection; current retentionUntil must be nonnull/future. Missing mapping returns None, never timestamp cast.
adapters.modelUse: Independent currentModelUse only, never storage derive/export. model_evidence_refs(Evidence tuple) resolves fresh exact original review/rights versions. authorize_model_use(*,request,input_bytes,deadline_ns)->proof binds complete ModelUseRequest, actual prepared input bytes/hash, all identity/fence fields, current order-preserving evidence digest, validity, privacy and current grant. Optional model_use_request_factory(operation,input_bytes,evidence_refs,deadline_ns) creates FULL request from host-verified pins for eligibility-only canonical evidence tokenize probe. Actual provider must request independent proofs before/after real tokenize/completion disclosures; absence fails closed.
adapters.modelOneShot: ModelUseProof.externalDispatchAllowed is true only for first durable budget admission of exact requestId/hash. Provider requires literal true BEFORE external dispatch. AFTER reuses exact original request ID/hash/bytes and allows false dispatch while requiring current allowed proof. currentModelUse is effectful for budget admission: lost response is unknown, never automatic retry/new attempt. No cached allowed proof permits resend.
adapters.artifacts: stage(*,artifact_id,content,content_type,canonical_digest=None,lineage_artifact_ids=(),collection_id=None,rights_policy_id=None,rights_version=None)->WorkerArtifactRef; read(*,artifact_id,expected_digest,collection_id=None)->bytes; strict canonical base64 roundtrip + raw SHA, raw artifact max1048576. publish_record; put_if_absent Strategy plan; publish_experiment BacktestRun artifact; publish exact private profile/public AgentRun pair through ONE publishAgent commit.
adapters.datasets: datasets.publish(plan)->WorkerResult; stages bounded source bytes under manifest.storageRef, stages canonical records, publishes DatasetManifest artifactId=datasetId. No private/raw stage ID used as public artifact FK lineage.
adapters.collections: publish_collection/publish; read_snapshot/read; activate_snapshot/activate; rollback uses explicit active-snapshot CAS. Publication sends exact reconstructionArtifact+manifestSha256+rightsPins. Reading uses only server-returned committed reconstruction reference, strict original byte hashes, exact public import refs, and existing KnowledgeService._check_plan; no guessed prefix access. Raw source lineage uses source contentHash + index membership, not public parent FK.
adapters.retrieval: KnowledgeService.retrieve converted to agents.types.RetrievalResult and StagedCitation preserving original evidence bytes; scope, authorization object, deadline and cancellation checked.
adapters.completionOutputs: Only durable public artifact IDs may enter host complete. Existing AgentRunPublisher internal artifact_ids includes private advisory ID; host must filter/use public runId or Worker status.outputArtifactIds. Private advisory is not complete output authority.

privateKnowledgeIndex.authority: Exact private index linked atomically by server collection publication. Public imported source/evidence membership and byte checks remain authoritative; index prefix itself grants no access.
